verifier: blind Claude agent re-implementation from the brief only; comparison computed by compare_independent.py (agent verification, not human)
ambiguities: Linescores: only L (count of '{...}' items in home_linescores) is used downstream, so period/value parsing+sorting was not needed; every {...} item is counted even if its period/value is None or the 'period' key is absent. Schedule files without a home_linescores column give L=0.
status_period NaN compares false against P, so NP falls back to L.
CBB fast_break_points is absent from most box files; missing source columns become NaN (fb100 and everything derived is NaN there).
Venue edge E(x): a season's gap_u counts as 'available' only if both home and away non-neutral means are non-NaN; E for the defensive adjustment uses E of the offensive metric x, as written.
site/home for E and hca: home rows are rows with site == +1 (non-neutral and team_home_away == 'home').
LG fallback (season s-1 mean) is applied per metric when no earlier same-season row has a non-NaN value; the same lg_x (of the offensive metric) is used for d_x series.
SHR prior target for stage-2 series uses the mean of the adjusted series itself (a_x / a_d_x) over the team's season s-1 rows; n counts non-NaN earlier same-season values of that series.
SHR 'if target is NaN the result is ew' — ew returned as is (may be NaN).

WF 'distinct seasons' counts seasons present among training rows of the universe, regardless of whether the fit inputs are finite there; if a fit has zero usable rows, OLS/logistic outputs NaN for that season.
OLS apply gives NaN when any column is NaN (plain arithmetic).
rest: day difference to the team's previous row (any season) in step-5 order, capped at 7 (no lower bound; same-day = 0).
pace_slow_pre = NaN if either pace_pre is NaN.
poss_sd: sd per mtype of pace - exp_poss_joint_pre over training rows; a group with <2 non-NaN residuals gives NaN.
hca fit with no finite residuals -> NaN -> 0.

z-scores: the <200 test counts rows of the season dated strictly before d; with >=200 rows mu/sd are point-in-time population moments over non-NaN V; fallback uses previous-season mean and ddof-1 sd (NaN if no previous season).
log(max(tot_res^2, 0.25)) is NaN when tot_res is NaN.
ter: NaN for seasons where WF yields NaN (so those rows are excluded from rho fits); otherwise searchsorted (NaN sqrt(ep) -> 2).

rho/k cells: lookup keyed on the row's (bk, ter) / (fav, bk); NaN key or unseen cell -> pooled. Group stat used when n > 5 even if it evaluates to NaN. Pooled requires > 50 fit rows. Sign flip for fav != 1 (fav = 0 when exp_margin is NaN or <= 0).
k_pts_margin fit groups use fav of all rows (no fav filter), cov and var both ddof 1.
p_ot2_given_ot counts are over all training rows (ot_n NaN counts as neither).
Logistic: X columns standardised with population sd over the usable training rows.
